title: Palm: A Culturally Inclusive and Linguistically Diverse Dataset for Arabic LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the factual correctness and cultural awareness of LLMs using LLM-as-a-judge and human evaluation on country-specific open-ended instructions covering diverse Arab traditions, geography, and celebrations.

Measuring language and dialectal consistency of generated responses, and comparing model correctness across prompts written in Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) versus regional Arabic dialects (DA) from 22 Arab countries.
